name: smuhub
description: SMUhub: one build, one server. The API serves the built web app in production.

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.build:client: npx --yes pnpm@12.21.0 --dir client install --frozen-lockfile --prod=false && npx --yes pnpm@12.21.0 --dir client build
scripts.build:server: npm --prefix server ci --include=dev && npm --prefix server run build
